newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Vision forms A$30.6 mln R&D syndicate.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Vision forms A$30.6 mln R&D syndicate.

text.p: Vision Systems Ltd said on Wednesday it had finalised the establishment of a A$30.6 million research and development syndicate for subsidiary Australian Biomedical Corp Ltd (ABCL).
The company said the syndicate would fund a A$12.6 million R&D programme over three years aimed at developing a further high value, automated medical instrument for the world market.
The instrument would operate in the clinical laboratory market in the area of biochemical analysis, it said in a statement.
Vision Systems said exports of high value manufactured products continued to grow and should exceed A$60 million in the current financial year.
The company also manufactures video-based security systems and high sensitivity smoke particle detection systems.
At 12.43 p.m. (0243 GMT), its shares were five cents lower at A$10.05.
